description:
Cast Haze of Rage with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Haze of Rage's storm ability, Blood Funnel and Judith trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Judith trigger, creating a 2/2 Imp creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Imp.
When the Imp dies, it triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Haze of Rage trigger, copying it for each spell cast before it this turn.
Resolve all Haze of Rage spells.
Repeat.

uses.name: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty
